Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> wants to keep training. Should I let her?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングを続けたがっている。大丈夫だろうか？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> continue de vouloir entraîner. Est-ce que ça va ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> setzt das Training fort. Ist das in Ordnung?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ยังคงฝึกฝนต่อไป จะไม่เป็นไรใช่ไหม?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> Tiếp tục huấn luyện. Không sao chứ?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 이럴 땐 오히려 쉬어 줘야 해.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: こういう時こそ、休んだほうがいい。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 这种时候反而该好好休息才行。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 這種時候反而該好好休息才行。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Dans ce cas, il faut bien te laisser partir.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: In diesem Fall solltest du dir eine Pause gönnen.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Vaya, parece que me he equivocado de camino.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Nesse momento, deveria dar um descanso.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ในกรณีนี้คุณควรให้พักหน่อย
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Thôi nào, chúng ta nên đi thôi.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: よし、もう少しやってみよう！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Gut, lass es uns noch einmal versuchen!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ดีเลย ลองทำอีกหน่อย!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Được rồi, thử thêm chút nữa xem!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je donne la potion de vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le doy una poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ฉันจะมอบพลังชีวิตให้
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Tôi đang trao một chai thuốc hồi sức.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: I took a short break with <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>と一緒に短い休憩を取った。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a pris une pause pour se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้พักผ่อนอย่างสั้นๆ แล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã cùng nhau nghỉ ngơi ngắn một chút.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ended the training session with a troubled look on her face.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は思い悩んだ様子でトレーニングを終えた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>带着心烦意乱的表情结束了训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>帶著心煩意亂的表情結束了訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a terminé l'entraînement avec un visage troublé.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat die Übung mit einem ernsten Gesicht beendet.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terminó el entrenamiento con una expresión descontenta.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terminou o treino com uma expressão desanimada.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้เสร็จสิ้นการฝึกฝนด้วยใบหน้าที่แสดงถึงความเหนื่อยล้า
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengakhiri latihan dengan penampilan yang mengesankan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hoàn thành bài tập bằng một khuôn mặt nghiêm túc.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> finished the training session looking relieved.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は晴れやかな表情でトレーニングを終えた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>带着轻松的表情结束了训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>帶著輕鬆的表情結束了訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a terminé ses entraînements avec un visage détendu.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terminó el entrenamiento con una expresión tranquila.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terminou os treinos com uma expressão tranquila.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้ฝึกฝนด้วยรูปลักษณ์ที่น่าทึ่ง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengakhiri latihan dengan penampilan yang luar biasa.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hoàn thành bài tập với một nụ cười rạng rỡ.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s condition didn't improve, so we stopped the training session.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>のコンディションは回復せず、トレーニングを中断した。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 由于<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的状态未能恢复，因而中断了训练。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 由於<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>的狀態未能恢復，因而中斷了訓練。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: La condition de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ne s'est pas rétablie, l'entraînement a été interrompu.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s Zustand hat sich nicht erholt, das Training wurde unterbrochen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> Mi condición no se recuperó, así que interrumpí el entrenamiento.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> Interrompeu o treino pois a condição não melhorou.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: สภาพของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ยังไม่ฟื้นฟู และการฝึกฝนก็หยุดลง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s condition did not recover, so training was interrupted.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tình trạng của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> không được khôi phục, bài tập đã bị gián đoạn.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 다행히도 포션을 마신 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 기운을 되찾은 듯했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Thankfully, the potion seemed to have restored <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s energy.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 活力ポーションを飲んだ<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、元気を取り戻したようだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 幸好喝了药水的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎恢复了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 幸好喝了藥水的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎恢復了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Heureusement, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retrouvé de la vitalité.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Glücklicherweise schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, der den Trank getrunken hatte, wieder zu Kräften zu kommen.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Ainda bem que tomou a poção e recuperou o ânimo de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: โชคดีที่ได้รับ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่กำลังฟื้นฟูพลัง
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: May mắn thay, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hồi phục tinh thần.
